---
title: "Reorientation of oxidized lipid tails"
description: "An oxidized phospholipid tail reverses orientation and brings its polar terminus toward the aqueous interface."
order: 4
---

A shortened oxidized lipid tail capped by a polar group can reorient toward the membrane surface, changing the local membrane environment.
